meta.title: Download plans
meta.description: Laser-cut digital plans for Contraption Cart designs are available for download on Etsy.

blocks.content:
Digital plans for my designs are available for download on my Etsy shop. You’ll find the same sections there as on this site — automata, magic tricks, puzzle boxes, toys and games, and whirligigs — but downloadable plans are mixed in with the physical kits and posted items.

Look for listings marked as digital downloads when you browse.
